newEntry.name: Chord & Lattice
newEntry.desc: Snip twenty runners, seat three double-tenoned struts between two pierced crowns and lace indexed soft-thread chords into a hyperboloid sculpture. Measured sheet/carrier reference, adjustable eyes and calibrated joints, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL labels; connected-card, five part STLs and assembly ZIP. Thread and adhesive required.
